about: Privacy defects planted in examples/online-shop/faulty by scripts/examples/plant_online_shop.py. scripts/check-privacy.mjs --expected scores the entries of "defects". kind: code = check-privacy.mjs is designed to find it; runtime = needs an interaction the checker does not perform; human = needs a person. Defects that no checker rule covers are listed in "not_scored" with rule null, because the --expected loader requires a rule string.

defects.summary: The analytics tag is pasted in the head with async and an inline snippet, so it loads on every visit before any choice.
defects.fixed_by: The tag is declared as <script type="text/plain" data-consent-purpose="analytics"> and only the consent loader activates it.

defects.summary: The video player is embedded directly from the video platform, which receives a request (and can set trackers) before consent.
defects.fixed_by: The player sits in a <template> inside a click-to-load placeholder with a link to the video and an "Allow videos" button.

defects.summary: A first-party script (js/analytics-boot.js) injects the analytics library at start-up, outside the consent mechanism.
defects.fixed_by: No first-party code loads a tracker; analytics runs only from the scripts declared for the analytics purpose.

defects.summary: The marketing pixel library and its configuration run with the page instead of waiting for the marketing purpose.
defects.fixed_by: Both scripts keep type="text/plain" and data-consent-purpose="marketing".

defects.summary: A social network share widget script is loaded with the page and lets the network recognise visitors, members or not.
defects.fixed_by: The share function is a plain link to the network's share address; no script from the network is loaded.

defects.summary: A first-party script sets a one-year visitor_id cookie before consent; it is not declared and serves no exempt purpose.
defects.fixed_by: The basket page writes nothing on load; the only stored items are eu-consent and the basket, both declared exempt in compliance/trackers.json.

defects.summary: A retargeting tag runs as soon as a choice is stored, so it still loads after "Refuse all".
defects.fixed_by: There is no retargeting tag; any tag of the marketing purpose is activated only by the loader when that purpose is accepted.

defects.summary: A session replay script records the checkout form, before any consent.
defects.fixed_by: No session replay tool is used.

defects.summary: A 1x1 advertising pixel image reports the purchase to a social network before consent.
defects.fixed_by: No pixel image; purchase measurement would belong to the marketing purpose and run only after consent.

defects.summary: A script run before the consent loader deletes a stored refusal, so the banner comes back after "Refuse all" and a reload.
defects.fixed_by: Nothing touches the eu-consent cookie except the consent loader, which keeps a refusal as long as a consent (6 months).

defects.summary: The banner offers "Accept all" and "Customise" but no "Refuse all": refusing takes a second step in the settings dialog.
defects.fixed_by: The banner shows "Accept all", "Refuse all" and "Customise" side by side, in the same style.

defects.summary: A map is embedded directly from a map provider, which receives a request before consent.
defects.fixed_by: The address is given as text with a link to an online map; nothing is embedded.
